Extended because CI never translates; the model weights come from the local cache on top.
# imports: transformers
transformers

Imported inside that one subcommand, so the other four run without it. The wheel is 7.2 MB (vosk 0.3.45, measured 2026-10-06), and it needs a speech model the caller supplies on top. Extended because nothing in CI transcribes, so CI should not pay for it.
